note: DEV set, written 2026-09-28 by the independent review of PR #74 (fix/guards-negation-bypass) as adversarial probes of the round-3 rules. Not a held-out number: the fixes in the same review were made against it. rv-flag- cases are stated verdicts the whole pipeline let through on PR head 5ddd31e and on main 923ed38 (plural check nouns after after/when, we-should-go-ahead, fair/safe/needless to say, a leading reason or a list of no-phrases, not only, zero-width and soft-hyphen characters); rv-pass- cases are look-alikes, three of which (without / with no ... whether / if) PR head 5ddd31e flagged and main did not. record_guard lists 'all covered' sentences PR head let through and main struck (trailing condition, reported, quoted, hedged, 不仅) and conditions both must let through. claim_check lists list-marker cases the whole-sentence correction must keep. Sentences are SYNTHETIC. Scored by scripts/eval_verdicts.py --check (cases) and scripts/test_guards_round3.py (all sections).
